retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered photographic collage featuring high-contrast stage lighting and centered, ultra-thin geometric sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, dark photographic montage composed of multiple live performance shots and portraits, unified by deep shadows and intense red/magenta stage lighting, with a central block of white, thin-weight typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping photographic layers creating a sense of motion
High-contrast lighting separating subjects from deep black backgrounds
Centralized typographic hierarchy floating over the busiest part of the image
Warm color palette dominated by reds, magentas, and deep blacks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple subjects at varying scales; larger figures on the right and top-left, with a row of smaller portraits at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white text block in the upper-center third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement from the top-left performer, down through the central text, to the row of faces at the bottom, and up the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of 'crushed blacks' to blend disparate photos into a single cohesive field.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high contrast with saturated warm tones against zero-value blacks.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Thin geometric display paired with a sturdier, more legible grotesque for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Framed logo box in bottom corner

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and thin stroke of the era.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and sharp apexes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, high-contrast photographic collage of a 1960s rock band performing live. Use multiple overlapping exposures. Apply a heavy red and magenta color grade to the highlights while keeping shadows deep black. Include a row of five distinct male portraits at the bottom edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center-align a block of white text in the upper-middle section. Use an ultra-thin geometric sans-serif for the main title in all-caps. Below it, arrange secondary text in two columns using a medium-weight sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the background a collage of multiple photos?
Is the color palette dominated by red and black?
Is the main title text ultra-thin and all-caps?
Is the text centered and white?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital clarity; maintain film grain and high-contrast 'crushed' blacks.
Ensure text is perfectly centered regardless of background complexity.
recipe.reuseFormula: Collage(Live Performance Photos) + ColorGrade(Red/Black High Contrast) + Typography(Centered, White, Ultra-Thin Geometric Sans) = 60s Psychedelic Rock Aesthetic
